root_cause.text: The uvcvideo start_streaming error path in `uvc_start_streaming_video()` failed to return already queued `vb2` buffers when `uvc_pm_get()` failed, leaving the videobuf2 queue in an inconsistent state during streaming startup failure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (ret) return ret;` after `uvc_pm_get(stream->dev);` to `goto err_buffers;` and adds `uvc_queue_return_buffers(queue, UVC_BUF_STATE_QUEUED);`, while the CVE/commit explicitly says “Return buffers if streaming fails to start due to uvc_pm_get() error” and references a `vb2_start_streaming` warning.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The uvcvideo start_streaming error path in `uvc_start_streaming_video()` failed to return already queued `vb2` buffers when `uvc_pm_get()` failed, leaving the videobuf2 queue in an inconsistent state during streaming startup failure.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes `if (ret) return ret;` after `uvc_pm_get(stream->dev);` to `goto err_buffers;` and adds `uvc_queue_return_buffers(queue, UVC_BUF_STATE_QUEUED);`, while the CVE/commit explicitly says “Return buffers if streaming fails to start due to uvc_pm_get() error” and references a `vb2_start_streaming` warning.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix streaming startup error handling by unwinding queued buffers on all failures and releasing the PM reference only when acquired.
intent_record.what: The function's error handling was changed so that a failure from uvc_pm_get(stream->dev) no longer returns immediately but jumps to a new err_buffers label, and a failure from uvc_video_start_streaming(stream) now jumps to a new err_pm label. A successful uvc_video_start_streaming() call now returns 0 explicitly, while the new err_pm path calls uvc_pm_put(stream->dev) and then falls through to err_buffers, which calls uvc_queue_return_buffers(queue, UVC_BUF_STATE_QUEUED) before returning ret.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this ensures queued buffers are returned to the queued state on both power-management acquisition failure and streaming-start failure, while still releasing the PM reference only when it was successfully acquired. This prevents buffers from being left stranded in an inconsistent state during startup errors.

grouping_result.intent: Fix streaming startup error handling by unwinding queued buffers on all failures and releasing the PM reference only when acquired.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it fixes the start_streaming error path to return/unwind already queued vb2 buffers on failure and ensures PM references are only released when successfully acquired.

candidates.rationale: This branch immediately exits on uvc_pm_get() failure, triggering the vulnerable error path. Because it returns before queued vb2 buffers are unwound, it directly embodies the missing cleanup root cause.
This early return on uvc_pm_get() failure is the direct cause of leaving already queued buffers unreleased, resulting in an inconsistent vb2 queue state during streaming startup failure.

vuln_statements.explanation: This early return on the uvc_pm_get() failure path exits uvc_start_streaming_video() before the function unwinds already queued vb2 buffers, which is the root cause of the inconsistent queue state during streaming startup failure.
This conditional guards the failure path after uvc_pm_get(); together with the immediate return, it selects the error path that skips returning already queued vb2 buffers.
